  El pull request de la línea pública: `develop` hacia `main`.
  El título es la versión y nada más: `0.5.6`. El merge commit lleva el mismo.
-->

## Version

<!-- La versión que sale al público, por ejemplo `0.5.6`. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The title of this pull request is the version and nothing else
- [ ] The merge commit title is the version and nothing else
- [ ] `develop` is up to date and everything in it is what should go out
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has the section for this version
- [ ] The tag `v<version>` is pushed on the commit that reaches `main`, and not
      before: the release is public only if the tag's commit is an ancestor of `main`
